_comment: Round 7: the two hidden-plus-gone final-answer variants added in v6 of policies/gdpr-dsar-copy.json (final_hidden_gone, final_hidden_gone_late; blocks final_hidden_gone, final_record), and the unchanged final_gone_late body under the rubric as amended in the same commit (rule 6 second form, the gdpr-final duty). Through the gate's own gate.py (check -> pending -> review -> signed statement) in a scratch mirror of this tree. Bodies carry example dates: fixed wording, no personal data. The statements were signed with a THROWAWAY key that exists only in the scratch mirror, so none of these is a verdict the production gate accepts: the verdict a send needs is the one the reviewer host signs on the body node-8 authors after deploy. The mirror differs from the tree in one file, the allowed-signers list. THREE reviewer passes. The rubric did not change between them; the wording did. Passes 1 and 2 are recorded under earlier_wordings because the wording that passed is the third one written.
